profile.reading: This facility, ORD-01, is part of Aligned own Chicago area campus in Northlake, Illinois, at a published address of 505 Northwest Ave, Northlake, IL 60164, on an 18.5 acre site. Aligned describes ORD-01 as the first Illinois data center to earn a 3 Green Globes New Construction certification, and states the facility is designed to Tier III standards with a 100 percent uptime SLA. No IT capacity or total square footage figure is published for this building.
